activities_related_record_check.name: activities_related_record_check
activities_related_record_check.value: "crm"."activities"."prospect_id" IS NOT NULL OR "crm"."activities"."booking_id" IS NOT NULL OR "crm"."activities"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL

crew_assignments_name_check.name: crew_assignments_name_check
crew_assignments_name_check.value: "crm"."crew_assignments"."person_id" IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(trim("crm"."crew_assignments"."freeform_name"), '') IS NOT NULL

occurrence_races_duration_positive_check.name: occurrence_races_duration_positive_check
occurrence_races_duration_positive_check.value:
("crm"."occurrence_races"."estimated_duration_minutes" IS NULL OR "crm"."occurrence_races"."estimated_duration_minutes" > 0)
        AND ("crm"."occurrence_races"."duration_override_minutes" IS NULL OR "crm"."occurrence_races"."duration_override_minutes" > 0)

prospects_source_check.name: prospects_source_check
prospects_source_check.value: "crm"."prospects"."race_listing_id" IS NOT NULL OR "crm"."prospects"."event_id" IS NOT NULL

tasks_related_record_check.name: tasks_related_record_check
tasks_related_record_check.value: "crm"."tasks"."prospect_id" IS NOT NULL OR "crm"."tasks"."booking_id" IS NOT NULL OR "crm"."tasks"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL
